constraint_text: The Agent must use the available tools to answer the question and must not rely on internal pre-trained knowledge. The Agent is allowed to make up to 4 tool calls in total and must make at least 2 tool calls to complete the task. The Agent must solve the task within a maximum of 2 interaction rounds. The Agent is permitted to invoke the 'historical_event_tool' at most 2 times in the course of solving the task. The final answer must be between 100 and 200 characters in length to ensure sufficient detail while maintaining conciseness.
